identitySignals: Company website (gdvi.net, reached from globalmodular.net) names 'Global Modular, Inc.' at 450 Commerce Ave. Atwater, CA 95301, matching the agenda name and the 'Atwater, CA' location

Website describes modular relocatable school buildings and classrooms, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' contracts; the Fremont High School project included new modular classroom buildings
A 2003 press release says Global Modular, Inc. delivered six modular buildings ordered by Oakland Unified School District, showing a prior working relationship with OUSD
research.notes: Registry IDs (EIN, CA entity number, SAM UEI) were not looked up. Website domain gdvi.net belongs to the parent, Global Diversified Industries, but globalmodular.net redirects there and the pages present Global Modular, Inc. The 2003 press release placed the parent in Chowchilla, CA; the company's current site gives Atwater.

profile.summary: Global Modular, Inc. designs, manufactures and installs modular buildings in California. Its products include relocatable classrooms, cafeterias, gymnasiums, laboratories, child care centers, restrooms and administrative buildings, mainly for schools and other institutions.

sources.title: Global Diversified Industries, Inc. Commenced Delivery on Six Modular Buildings for California's Fifth Largest School District

review.notes: The cited company pages show Global Modular, Inc. at 450 Commerce Ave., Atwater, CA 95301, (866) 306-3700, which matches the agenda name and location. The page says the company designs, builds and installs modular school-type buildings. A 2003 press release names Global Modular as a subsidiary that delivered six buildings to OUSD. The summary is neutral and supported.
